objective: Enter one defensible agricultural/settlement calibration attempt; stop treating successive source transcriptions and manufactured tests as fitted historical evidence.

milestones.name: Close cereal seed/area units
milestones.deliverable: Reviewed conditional wheat/barley crosswalk; no coefficient change.

milestones.name: Freeze one baseline, free parameter and matched target
milestones.deliverable: A single calibration-entry decision with exact baseline input identities, one estimand/parameter set, evidence denominators/dates and comparison protocol. Operator/draft capacities remain supplied scenarios unless eligible observations qualify.

milestones.name: Fit and compare
milestones.deliverable: Bounded fit only to eligible target observations, with simple baseline and a declared withheld comparison where possible. Report uncertainty/identifiability and preserve failed comparisons. A fit to a chosen grain-coverage target is development calibration, not historical validation.

current_input_gate: Existing city-area targets support conditional settlement-area development and have already been fitted. Prescribed Columella task counts constrain definitions, not observed annual resource supply. Current packets newly qualify no matched operator/draft availability, actual household work allocation or AD200 people-per-inhabited-hectare target. Do not use catalogue areas, chosen95% coverage or manufactured controls as surrogate observations of those quantities.
bounded_target_screen: Within milestone2, at most three targeted searches and two original scholarly/data-method bodies for one farm-account candidate family with paired field area, defined operation/crew time or animal service. Prefer source dates near AD200. Record precise dates and treat other Roman periods/regions as transfer evidence, not an exactAD200 target. No eligibility claim from search snippets. If numerator/denominator or access is missing, return an explicit no-fit entry decision instead of adding unconstrained parameters.
entry_requirements: separation of training and evaluation uses
counting: Three milestones from the user question; completing1 leaves baseline/evidence and fit/evaluation. This is a work-package count, not a guaranteed number of source discoveries, turns or time estimate. Evidence failure blocks an empirical fit.
exclusions: No new full-planet scenario sweep, invented historical resource stocks, crop-mix adoption, reserved Buringh/workbook access, warehouse detour, climate development, atlas/default change or automatic population adoption.
